column1: # What this package answers, in Ukrainian, over `gazetteer-uk.tsv`.
# The same four columns as `en.tsv`: query, filters, and the name, kind and
# country of the hit that must come back first.
# Shorter than the English table on purpose. Most of what `en.tsv` asserts —
# proximity against population, a bbox admitting one of two, the postal index —
# is script-independent, and repeating it in Cyrillic would assert the ranker
# twice and the language not at all. What is here is the part that is genuinely
# about the script: the case fold, the prefix band, and the ambiguity between a
# name and the longer name it starts.
# query
# The fold is Unicode-aware, not ASCII: Cyrillic uppercase has to lower.
київ
КИЇВ
# `київ` is a prefix of `Київська область`, so both match and the shorter, exact
# one has to win. This is the row that fails if `similarity` scores a prefix hit
# without discounting it by how much of the name is still untyped.
київ
# A city and a river sharing a name, in a second script.
дніпро
дніпро
# The feature classes, each named once.
україна
говерла
# Plain wins, including the three cities that exist only to give the ranker
# something to reject.
львів
одеса
харків
# Places outside Ukraine, under their Ukrainian names — which is the fact that
# makes `lang` the whole internationalization story: these are rows GeoNames
# already holds, not a translation this repository maintains.
варшава
париж
лондон
# A country filter that agrees with the answer must not lose it.
київ
